title: Top-down PLM assembly with single-relation temporal-memory isolation
question: Can a persistent multi-timescale state solve a fixed history-dependent temporal decision when hidden relation-family variation is removed?
hypothesis: If the persistent state mechanism is sufficient for temporal memory, a fixed single temporal contrast should be solved substantially better than no-state and should expose whether the earlier multi-family benchmark imposed an additional hidden-context bottleneck.

endpoints.name: exact_class_balanced_success
endpoints.description: Exact held-out action success on one fixed temporal contrast with exact-negation history pairs; primary decision at H=256.

endpoints.name: history_conditioned_action_gap
endpoints.description: Fraction of paired histories with identical current observation and opposite correct actions for which the model chooses opposite actions.

endpoints.name: state_intervention_effect
endpoints.description: Frozen MTSK checkpoint success after state reset or cross-episode shuffle.

endpoints.name: representation_sign_accuracy
endpoints.description: Analytical sign agreement between MTSK fast/slow state coordinates and the fixed temporal contrast.

endpoints.name: evaluation_work
endpoints.description: Explicit evaluation work under the common state/update accounting.

decision_rule.condition: At H=256, MTSK exceeds single_timescale by more than 0.10 and the seed-bootstrap 95% interval excludes zero, while MTSK also exceeds no_state.
decision_rule.licenses: bounded evidence that multiple persistent temporal scales improve the isolated fixed-relation memory task.
decision_rule.does_not_license: multi-family relation inference, general intelligence, biological equivalence, multimodal competence, asymptotic scaling, or hardware speedup.

decision_rule.condition: All stateful arms materially outperform no_state but MTSK does not materially exceed single_timescale.
decision_rule.licenses: the isolated task establishes persistent-state usefulness but not a multi-timescale advantage.
the registered memory-isolation hypothesis is not established.

held_constant: ground-truth temporal contrast is exactly alpha=0.45 versus alpha=0.985
no pair-type or relation-family identifier is present because the relation family is fixed by the benchmark
test histories are generated only by the registered test seed stream
paired histories are exact negations with opposite labels
policy architecture and parameter count are identical across arms
optimizer family, learning rate, step count, evaluation size, executor, verifier, and state-work accounting
